title: Infrastructure automation and GitOps
lead: Replace manual changes with reviewed code, so every production change has a history and a rollback.
capsule: Prodory replaces manual infrastructure changes with reviewed code. We write Terraform or OpenTofu for cloud and data-centre resources, Ansible for server and operating-system lifecycle, and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or Flux. Each change passes a pull-request review and policy checks before it reaches production, and the repositories are created in your organisation.
why: Manual changes create drift that nobody can explain during an incident.
Platform teams need a reviewed, repeatable delivery path before an internal developer platform is worth building.
scope: Terraform and OpenTofu for cloud and data-centre resources
Ansible for server and OS lifecycle, including RHEL patching
GitOps delivery with review gates and policy checks
Migration of existing manual configuration into code
outcomes: Repositories in your own Git organisation
A pull-request workflow with policy gates
Module documentation and a maintenance guide

diagram.caption: Fig. 4 — Every production change passes one reviewed path, with policy and cost checks before deployment.

faqs.q: Do you work in our existing Git platform?
faqs.a: Yes. We work in GitHub, GitLab or your self-hosted Git, and the repositories sit in your organisation.

faqs.q: Can you move our manual setup into code?
faqs.a: Yes. We document what exists, codify it in small reviewed changes, and remove manual access once the code path is proven.
